name: 1Password
description: Create and manage 1Password Developer Environments, inspect variable names, and mount local .env files. Requires the 1Password desktop app on macOS or Linux with MCP Server enabled.

setup.title: Connect 1Password on your computer
setup.description: OpenTeam desktop connects directly to your installed 1Password app. No API key, hosted connector, or terminal setup is needed. Stored secret values stay in 1Password.
steps: Install or update 1Password on macOS or Linux, then unlock it.

In 1Password, open Settings → Developer and select Integrate with MCP clients. Complete any macOS setup prompt. You can also check Developer → MCP Server in the main window. Older versions additionally require Settings → Labs → MCP Server; its absence from Labs is normal in current versions. If Developer has no MCP option, check with 1Password or your administrator.
Keep OpenTeam desktop open on the same computer as 1Password. Select Connect here, then approve the authorization prompt in 1Password.
Grant the connection to the Bots that should use it. 1Password prompts again for access to individual environments, and authorization ends when 1Password locks.
